lines.en: Short legs, quick steps — don't underestimate me.
This cloned body is light as air.
Circling you, hunting a gap.
Another me steps out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 脚步踩着气，几乎不落地。
lines.en: I tread on ki, barely touching ground.
Small target — hard to hit.

lines.zh: 这双腿倒记得怎么走位。
lines.en: These legs still remember footwork.
Don't turn your back, I'll go around.

lines.zh: 克隆的肌肉记着旧招式。
lines.en: Cloned muscles recall old moves.
Sliding low across the ground.
Three looks a step, ready to dodge.
This body obeys better than the original.
My bald head glares in the sun.
This body doesn't need to eat.
Counting my opponent's openings.
Can a clone stare into nothing?
Rolling my knuckles — crack.

lines.zh: 我记得他的每一个动作。
lines.en: I remember every one of his moves.
Ki spinning in my palm, held back.
No heartbeat. Strange.

lines.zh: 主人给了我一副假躯壳。
lines.en: The master gave me a false shell.
I wait for someone to start it.
A moment more and my ki fills.

lines.zh: 我只是一段被复制的记忆。
lines.en: I'm just a copied memory.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: Wind passes through. I barely feel it.
I'll remember that face.
Stop staring. I'm not him.
Did you know the real Krillin?
I'm less merciful than he was.
Your ki is faint. Far too faint.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，就是我的靶子。
lines.en: Standing there makes you my target.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟往后挪了半寸，怕了。
lines.en: Your heel slid back half a step; you are afraid.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛看穿你的架势。
lines.en: These eyes read your stance.

lines.zh: 你手上那道疤从哪来的？
lines.en: Where'd that scar on your hand come from?

lines.zh: 这具身体比你想象的快。
lines.en: This body is faster than you think.
You're measuring my range, aren't you.

lines.zh: 走近些，让我看看你的胆子。
lines.en: Come closer, let me see your nerve.

lines.zh: 克隆不需要对手，只需要目标。
lines.en: A clone needs no rival, only a target.

lines.zh: 笑吧，等会儿就笑不出来。
lines.en: Laugh now. You won't in a moment.
The pain was copied over.

lines.zh: 我后退一步，重新算距离。
lines.en: Step back and recalculate the gap.
Shoulder's gone numb.
This shell of mine still holds.
A hit only sharpens me.
Blood runs from my lip to my chin.
Don't celebrate — I'm not down.
This pain is familiar.
I can still move. Enough.
Food? This body doesn't need it.

lines.zh: 你把饭团举那么高做什么。
lines.en: Why hold that rice ball up so high?
I smell cooked rice.
The old me loved food. I don't.
Even if I ate, I'd taste nothing.
Is this meant to bribe me?
I stare at it out of habit.

lines.zh: 这身体需要的是气，不是饭。
lines.en: This body needs ki, not meals.
Take it away. Don't wave it at me.
Bumped me? You're too slow.
I slid away low.
Small frames hit hard too.

lines.zh: 你的重心偏了，我看得见。
lines.en: Your weight's off. I can see it.
Getting close just gives me an opening.
This body's tougher than you think.
Don't shoulder me — I use elbows.
Back off, don't step on me.
Clones have no such thing.
This body was manufactured.

lines.zh: 我连自己的记忆都是借的。
lines.en: Even my memories are borrowed.
I fight. That's all.
Wrong creature for that.
I have no home and no companion.

lines.zh: 这问题比拳头更让我烦。
lines.en: That question annoys me more than fists.
Keep your kindness.
I picked up this dumpling.
A stone on the ground — good to throw.
This strip of cloth wraps a hand.
I pick it up out of curiosity only.
Old memories bent me down.
Is this useful in a fight?
A copper coin. Shiny.
Slipping a pill into my robe.
You're marked. Don't bother running.
You move, I move.
This gap is one step for me.
Ki sense is clear. Right there.
Cut off his retreat first.
Target confirmed. Moving in.
You've an old wound. Perfect.
These eyes don't misjudge.
I stick close — you can't open distance.
He clenched a fist. Here it comes.
Count three and I'm at your face.
I've marked your center of gravity.
Coming from the flank — can't block.
This fight needs no lines.
You're already in my range.
Half a circle to read your reaction.
There's a hole in your guard.
I'm patient. You strike first.
Feint left, strike right.
This body dodges three times running.
He's raising that arm too high.
Ground's slick. Noted.
One more step and I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 你退了三次，都在同一格。
lines.en: Three retreats, all to the same spot.
I don't chase. I wait.
When that breath runs out you'll slow.

lines.zh: 他手上的东西是障眼法。
lines.en: That thing in his hand is a decoy.
Walking inside your shadow.
Closing the gap to half a pace.
The more you rush, the more you err.
One breath. Just one.
A short frame can still punch through!
This elbow's aimed at the ribs.
Three quick punches — don't block.
I'm inside your reach now.
Ki blast in my palm — catch.
This kick goes for your knee.
I hit a little harder than he did.
Landed it. Break off and reset.
Elbow, knee, heel.
You guard high, I go low.
Learned this from a memory.
Stay on him, give no breath.
Missed once — reposition at once.
Pull back half a step, then again.
That one should make you remember me.
Another clone takes shape.
I was built out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 这副身体的记忆在回放。
lines.en: This body's memories are replaying.

lines.zh: 矮小的身形最容易被低估。
lines.en: A small shape is easiest to underestimate.

lines.zh: 我踩了踩地面，确认是真的。
lines.en: I press the ground to be sure it's real.
Ki cycled once through me.
The master wants me standing.
I open my eyes. The world is new.
This shell carries no warmth.

lines.zh: 先看看四周，再决定打谁。
lines.en: Look around, then choose a target.

lines.zh: 我活动着手指，找回感觉。
lines.en: Working my fingers, finding the feel.

lines.zh: 克隆不需要名字，只需要任务。
lines.en: A clone needs no name, only a task.

lines.zh: 我从光里走出，脚先落地。
lines.en: Out of the light, feet land first.

lines.zh: 这道影子长得像我，却不是我了。
lines.en: That shadow looks like me — but isn't.
The body woke before the mind.
I straighten up — a head shorter than before.

lines.zh: 我听见主人低语的声音。
lines.en: I hear my master's whisper.
The chains broke. I'm out.

lines.zh: 火烧到皮肤上，我却不太痛。
lines.en: Fire on my skin — it barely hurts.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，脚掌先着地。
lines.en: Fell from height, landed on my feet.

lines.zh: 水涌进来，这身体不需要气。
lines.en: Water floods in — this body needs no air.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出去，我稳住。
lines.en: The blast flung me; I held.
An arrow grazed my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股咒力想挤进我的意识。
lines.en: That spell tries to crawl into my mind.
I don't eat, yet I'm going weak.

lines.zh: 电流走遍四肢，短暂麻痹。
lines.en: Current through every limb — brief paralysis.
I'm falling, and the world shrinks.
